tasks.title: Set up Supabase Project and Database Schema
tasks.description: Initialize Supabase project and create the core database schema with all tables for the Back2Back OS platform
tasks.details: Create Supabase project and implement the complete database schema including: gyms, profiles, clients, classes, class_bookings, events, tasks, transactions, program_templates, gym_settings, membership_plans, client_memberships, access_jobs, invoices, line_items, exercises, workouts, performance_logs, and notifications tables. All tables must include gym_id for multi-tenancy and proper RLS policies.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all tables are created with correct relationships, RLS policies are enforced, and gym_id partitioning works correctly

subtasks.title: Create Supabase Project
subtasks.description: Set up new Supabase project with proper configuration
subtasks.details: Create new Supabase project in dashboard. Configure project settings, enable required extensions (uuid-ossp, pgcrypto). Set up database connection and API keys. Configure environment variables for local development.

subtasks.title: Create Core Tables - Gyms and Profiles
subtasks.description: Create gyms and profiles tables with proper relationships
subtasks.details: Create gyms table with id (uuid), name (text), timezone (text), kisi_place_id (integer). Create profiles table with id (uuid FK to auth.users), gym_id (uuid FK), role (text), full_name (text), experience_years (integer), specialties (text[]). Add proper indexes and constraints.

subtasks.title: Create Client Management Tables
subtasks.description: Create clients and related client management tables
subtasks.details: Create clients table with id (uuid), gym_id (uuid FK), profile_id (uuid FK), status (text), nmi_customer_id (text), kisi_user_id (integer). Create client_memberships table for membership tracking. Add proper constraints and indexes.

subtasks.title: Create Class Management Tables
subtasks.description: Create classes, events, and booking tables
subtasks.details: Create classes table with id (uuid), gym_id (uuid FK), name (text), description (text), capacity (integer), duration_minutes (integer), program_template_id (uuid FK). Create class_bookings table for reservations. Create events table for scheduled classes. Add proper relationships and constraints.

subtasks.title: Create Financial Tables
subtasks.description: Create financial tracking and transaction tables
subtasks.details: Create transactions table with id (uuid), gym_id (uuid FK), client_id (uuid FK), amount_cents (integer), type (text), status (text), nmi_transaction_id (text). Create invoices and line_items tables. Create membership_plans table. Add proper financial constraints and indexes.

subtasks.title: Create Performance Tracking Tables
subtasks.description: Create workout and performance tracking tables
subtasks.details: Create exercises table with id (uuid), gym_id (uuid FK), name (text), category (text), equipment_needed (text[]). Create workouts table for workout templates. Create performance_logs table for tracking client progress. Add proper relationships and constraints.

subtasks.title: Create System Configuration Tables
subtasks.description: Create gym settings and configuration tables
subtasks.details: Create gym_settings table with gym_id (uuid PK), reservation_open_time (time), reservation_close_time (time), cancellation_window_hours (integer), late_fee_cents (integer), no_show_fee_cents (integer). Create tasks table for task management. Create notifications table for system notifications. Add proper constraints.

subtasks.title: Create Integration Tables
subtasks.description: Create tables for third-party integrations
subtasks.details: Create access_jobs table for Kisi integration job queue. Create kisi_access_group_map table for gym-specific access group mapping. Add proper job status tracking and retry mechanisms. Create webhook_logs table for tracking third-party webhook events.

tasks.title: Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) Policies
tasks.description: Set up comprehensive RLS policies for all tables to ensure proper data isolation between gyms and role-based access control
tasks.details: Create RLS policies for all tables that enforce gym_id-based data isolation and role-based permissions (admin, trainer, member). Policies should allow admins full access to their gym's data, trainers limited access to classes and clients, and members access only to their own data.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with different user roles to ensure data isolation and proper access control

subtasks.title: Enable RLS on All Tables
subtasks.description: Enable Row-Level Security on all database tables
subtasks.details: Enable RLS on gyms, profiles, clients, classes, class_bookings, events, transactions, invoices, exercises, workouts, performance_logs, gym_settings, tasks, notifications, access_jobs, and kisi_access_group_map tables. Verify RLS is properly enabled on each table.

subtasks.title: Create Gym-Based Access Policies
subtasks.description: Create RLS policies for gym-based data isolation
subtasks.details: Create RLS policies that restrict access to data based on gym_id. Users can only access data where their profile.gym_id matches the record's gym_id. Implement policies for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE operations on all gym-scoped tables.

subtasks.title: Create Role-Based Access Policies
subtasks.description: Create RLS policies for role-based access control
subtasks.details: Create RLS policies that implement role-based access control. Admins can access all data within their gym. Trainers can access class and client data within their gym. Members can only access their own profile and booking data. Implement proper role checking in policies.

subtasks.title: Create Profile Self-Access Policies
subtasks.description: Create RLS policies for users to access their own profiles
subtasks.details: Create RLS policies that allow users to read and update their own profile data. Users can only access their own profile record where profile.id = auth.uid(). Implement proper profile ownership validation in policies.

subtasks.title: Test RLS Policies
subtasks.description: Test all RLS policies to ensure proper data isolation
subtasks.details: Create test cases to verify RLS policies work correctly. Test gym isolation by creating multiple gyms and verifying users can only access their gym's data. Test role-based access by creating users with different roles and verifying access restrictions. Test profile self-access policies.

tasks.title: Set up Authentication and Authorization System
tasks.description: Implement Supabase Auth with JWT claims and role-based access control for the multi-tenant platform
tasks.details: Configure Supabase Auth with custom JWT claims for user roles (admin, trainer, member). Set up user registration, login, and profile management. Implement role-based middleware for API access control.
tasks.testStrategy: Test authentication flow, JWT token generation, and role-based access to different parts of the application

Implement branch protection rules that prevent merging unless all stages pass. Create automated deployment to staging environment after successful CI pipeline. Set up comprehensive test data seeding for integration tests.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CI pipeline blocks PRs with failing tests, low coverage, or linting errors. Verify integration tests run against isolated Supabase environment. Test E2E flows simulate real user interactions.

tasks.title: Implement WorkOS-Only Authentication System
tasks.description: Migrate from Supabase Auth to WorkOS-only authentication for maximum security, scalability, and development speed
tasks.details: Strategic decision to use WorkOS as single source of truth for user identity verification. Implement single "Sign In" button that redirects to WorkOS, create internal "Invite Staff" mechanism for pre-provisioning accounts, bridge WorkOS authentication to Supabase sessions for database access, and let WorkOS handle Magic Links vs Enterprise SSO based on email domain. This offloads 100% of password security liability to WorkOS experts while building for future enterprise SSO needs from day one.

subtasks.details: Set up WorkOS project and configure authentication settings. Configure environment variables for WorkOS API keys and endpoints. Set up WorkOS organizations for multi-tenant support. Configure magic link and SSO settings. Set up proper redirect URLs and webhook endpoints. This establishes the foundation for WorkOS-only authentication.

Build invitation email system with secure tokens. Create user onboarding flow for invited users. Implement role-based invitation permissions (owners can invite admins, admins can invite coaches, etc.). This enables controlled user growth while maintaining security.

Create logout functionality that clears WorkOS sessions. Implement error handling for authentication failures. Build loading states and user feedback during auth flow. This provides the simplest possible user experience while handling all authentication complexity.

Build JWT token generation for Supabase API access using WorkOS user data. Create middleware to validate WorkOS sessions and generate Supabase-compatible tokens. Implement user profile synchronization between WorkOS and Supabase. This enables continued use of Supabase RLS and database features while using WorkOS for authentication.

subtasks.details: Update AuthContext to use WorkOS instead of Supabase Auth. Replace login/logout pages with WorkOS authentication flow. Update auth hooks and utilities to work with WorkOS sessions. This ensures all server-side operations use WorkOS authentication while maintaining security.
